finding: Configured V2 total capacity3 reserves1 root slot. SubAgent admission at resident capacity2 can unload a completed idle resident by shutdown_and_wait and manager removal. LocalThreadStore shutdown removes its recorder, so a retained Arc is not proof of a live writer. The fixture moved its same worker flush to after completion and role assertions, before sibling admission. The original three flushes and shutdowns remain; only error context was added to the other two flushes.
runtime_scope: The old r16 failure did not include phase/role UUID binding, so the exact evicted runtime identity is not claimed as observed. This repairs a source-proven invalid lifetime assumption, pending the original complete gate.
shutdown_readback: SessionIo shutdown tolerates InternalAgentDied and awaits the same shared completion. It does not redo a recorder lookup after an already completed eviction.
